doc.title: FlowList - System Architecture Document
doc.snippet: FlowList follows a strict layered architecture with clear separation of concerns. Components are designed with container/presentational pattern, custom hooks for logic encapsulation, and compound component pattern for complex UIs.

doc.title: FlowList - Epics
doc.snippet: As a user, I want to quickly add a task, so that I can capture todos without friction. Acceptance criteria include quick add input, Enter key creation, validation, and error feedback.
